# Orvio 0.23

- Redesigned Search with a clear search bar, Movies / Series / Live TV filters and library shortcuts. Android TV includes visible remote-control focus.
- Home prepares its first complete selection before displaying it, instead of replacing temporary recent titles with Trending a few seconds later. Background chart updates are used on the next Home visit.
- Genre selections stay in the Genres menu. The separate Categories control only shows provider categories.
- Removed A–Z sorting and the redundant sort controls from Movies, Series and category menus. Collections keep newest-first order, or provider order when dates are unavailable.

On a first launch without saved charts, Home may briefly show a loading layout while the initial selection is prepared. Navigation remains available.
